title: Progressive MP4 Media Contract and Native Player
externalChecks: EXTERNAL VALIDATION PENDING until one owner-supplied compatible progressive MP4 is delivered through the intended private media path and play/pause/seek/WebVTT are verified on iPhone Safari and the second real viewing device
instructions: Implement only the V1 progressive-MP4 media contract, strict metadata validation, and a native HTML video probe page.
Do not add room state, Socket.IO room events, timeline synchronization, clock synchronization, chat, Redis, R2 credentials, upload/ingestion workers, HLS, DASH, or DRM.
Do not hardcode an external sample-movie dependency. The probe may accept a media URL and expected duration through query parameters so the real R2 asset can be tested later.
The media contract must include an immutable fingerprint using assetId, assetVersion, and expected duration, with optional byteLength/etag.
The player must use native progressive MP4 via HTMLVideoElement, playsInline, controls, and local WebVTT tracks.
loadedmetadata must validate actual duration against the expected fingerprint before declaring the asset valid.
Do not modify IPTV/live-TV code other than adding the isolated /watch-together route to client/App.tsx.
A task is not complete until pnpm watch:gate exits 0 and the GitHub Watch Together Gate is green.
After deterministic Gate D passes, stop. Do not begin Gate E synchronization calibration or Gate F sync-core work in the same branch.
